name: nff-brain-vscode
description: Visualize and edit your project's nff-brain knowledge graph — the local-first memory Claude Code recalls at every session start. Fully offline; nothing is hosted.

viewsWelcome.contents:
The brain graph opens as a full editor tab.
[Open Brain](command:nffBrain.open)

nffBrain.autoModel.description: Automatically type /model into the Claude Code terminal when the brain's novelty scoring requests a model switch (reads .nff-brain/model-request.json written by the nff-brain hooks).

nffBrain.autoModelNotify.description: Show a status-bar message whenever nff-brain switches the session model.

enumDescriptions: Use embeddings when the runtime is installed and a vector index exists.
Always attempt embeddings (loads the model on the first search).
Lexical search only — never load the embedding model.
nffBrain.semanticSearch.description: Blend embedding similarity into the graph search box, so queries match meaning and not just keywords. Requires the optional runtime: run `nff-brain semantic install` then `nff-brain index`. Lexical results always render first; the model loads lazily on the first search and adds ~100-200 MB to the extension host.
